name: Enmark-Olofsson Syndrome
source:
An unremarkable office worker returning from work decided to change his standard route home. In an alley, he met a crying woman. When he approached her to help her with something, the last thing he heard was the crackle of a stun gun. When he came to, he noticed that he was tied up. Where is he, what is this place?

[Translated From [url=https://anivisual.net/stuff/2-1-0-129]Anivisual[/url]]
translation:
一名平平无奇的上班族下班回家时，决定改变平时的路线。在一条小巷里，他遇到了一名哭泣的女人。当他走近并试图帮助她时，最后听到的是电击枪发出的噼啪声。醒来后，他发现自己被绑了起来。这里是哪里？这是什么地方？

[译自[url=https://anivisual.net/stuff/2-1-0-129]Anivisual[/url]]
